messages:
maya: Heads-up: planning to cut release/v1.13 tomorrow 10:00 PDT. Need someone to create the branch and confirm backport rules. TL;DR: who can own the branch and triage backports after cutoff?

alex: I can create the branch if no objections. Will also update changelog. pinging @jen for QA freeze window.

jen: QA freeze looks OK — can we make cutoff 09:30 PDT to give us 30m for smoke? :ok_hand: 

sanjay: Re infra note: please don't include DB migration changes after cutoff. If there's a must-fix, backports only for non-migrations.

maya: Good call. For backport process: 1) Author opens PR against release/v1.13 2) Add label `backport/1.13` and `backport/request` 3) Add a short justification in PR body and link to original PR 4) Add reviewers from the owning component

alex: I'll create the branch at 10:00 and post the SHA. Using this command:
```
git checkout -b release/v1.13 origin/main
git push origin release/v1.13
```

alex: Also setting up branch protection: require 1 approval + passing CI. Can ops/infra confirm they won't block the push? @sanjay

sanjay: Ops is good. We'll not enforce migration-related checks for the release branch, but will run full CI. If CI flakes, don't merge until green.

jen: QA will monitor the backport queue. Please prefix backport PR titles with `[backport v1.13]` so the bot can triage. I'll make a small test checklist.

release-bot: Automated: release branch release/v1.13 created at sha abc123def. Protecting branch with required status checks.

maya: Perfect — thanks alex and team. I'll post a brief changelog nudge in the morning and add a note in the release doc about the migration rule. :rocket:
